login.title: Sign in to Fikisha
login.subtitle: Enter your phone number and we will send you a one-time code.

mfa.enrolIntro: Admin accounts need a code from an authenticator app as well as the SMS code. Your admin tools unlock once this is done.
mfa.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Fikisha.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar).
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code it shows next, or type the setup key.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code to add Fikisha to your authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Can't scan? Type this setup key into the app:
mfa.backupHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your backup codes instead. Each works once.
mfa.backupBody: Keep these somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.body: This action needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
